# Content Authoring and Build Errors Checklist: The blog ("Drift & Convergence")

**Purpose**: Validate that the post file format, controlled topics, draft handling, required-field errors and address rules are complete, clear, consistent and measurable (Constitution Principles VI and I). This tests the requirements as written, not the implementation.
**Created**: 2026-09-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Items ask whether requirements are well written; none is evaluated yet.

## Post Schema Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all post settings listed with type, required or optional status and allowed values in one place, matching between the spec, data model and post-file contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-031, Data Model, Contracts §post-file]
- [x] CHK002 Is the accepted date format defined (date only or date and time, time zone) and is what counts as "unreadable" specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-033, US3-3]
- [x] CHK003 Are limits defined for title and summary (length, empty string, whitespace only, line breaks)? [Gap, Spec §FR-033]
- [x] CHK004 Is the treatment of unknown or misspelled settings stated in the spec, not only the contract? [Gap, Contracts §build-errors P11]
- [x] CHK005 Is the rule for duplicate topics in one post defined in the spec? [Gap, Contracts §build-errors P7]
- [x] CHK006 Are requirements defined for where feature images are stored, allowed formats and size limits, and what happens if the file is missing? [Gap, Spec §FR-031, Contracts §build-errors P9]
- [x] CHK007 Is "update date equal to publication date" addressed, not only "earlier than"? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-033, US3-8]
- [x] CHK008 Are the body content rules (heading levels allowed, level-1 heading, empty body, allowed components) stated as requirements rather than only contract rows? [Gap, Contracts §build-errors P18-P20]
- [x] CHK009 Is the image syntax for caption, description and width (normal, wide, full) specified so an author can write it without guessing? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023, FR-034]
- [x] CHK010 Is the file type requirement (`.mdx` only, no `.md`, no sub-folders, slug character set) in the spec, given the spec says only "a text file"? [Gap, Spec §FR-031, Contracts §build-errors P13-P15]

## Controlled Topics

- [x] CHK011 Is the single location of the topic list stated, and is the set of fields per topic (name, identifier, description, colour) fully specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK012 Are identifier rules for topics defined (character set, length, stability once a post uses it), given they form public addresses? [Gap, Spec §FR-001, FR-016]
- [x] CHK013 Are the initial four topics and their identifiers and colours recorded unambiguously? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK014 Is "distinct colour" for each topic defined measurably (how different, in both themes)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK015 Is the process for adding, renaming or removing a topic specified, including the effect on existing topic page addresses? [Gap, Spec §FR-034]
- [x] CHK016 Is the main-topic rule (first listed topic) consistent between the assumptions, entities and card requirements? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Key Entities, FR-011]
- [x] CHK017 Is a maximum number of topics per post specified, and its effect on card and title-card layout? [Gap]
- [x] CHK018 Are requirements defined for a topic with no published posts on the production build (pill row, topic page, sitemap)? [Coverage, Spec §US4-5]

## Draft and Build-Mode Handling

- [x] CHK019 Is "production build" defined unambiguously, covering local builds, preview deployments, pull-request builds and test builds? [Ambiguity, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §R3]
- [x] CHK020 Is the fail-safe direction specified for an undetectable build mode (drafts hidden or shown)? [Gap, Plan §R3]
- [x] CHK021 Are all surfaces where drafts must be absent on production enumerated and consistent (page, listings, topic pages, related, home, feed, sitemap, page counts)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-032, SC-004]
- [x] CHK022 Is the effect of excluding drafts on pagination (page counts, out-of-range 404) specified? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK023 Are the Draft notice's wording, placement and appearance on cards (not only on post pages) specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-032, US3-9]
- [x] CHK024 Are draft behaviours specified for the lead story, featured grid and related posts on preview builds? [Coverage, Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK025 Is the rule for a post that is both draft and featured defined for production? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [x] CHK026 Is the "sample post" labelling requirement specific enough (wording and placement) to distinguish samples from real drafts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-035]
- [x] CHK027 Is it stated whether sample posts are removed or kept once real posts exist? [Gap, Spec §FR-035]
- [x] CHK028 Is the assumption that preview drafts are visible to anyone with the preview address validated against indexing and privacy requirements (for example no-index on previews)? [Assumption, Spec §FR-032]

## Required-Field and Validation Errors

- [x] CHK029 Is "a clear message naming the file and the problem" defined with minimum content (file name, field, allowed values) and plain-language wording? [Clarity, Spec §FR-033, SC-003]
- [x] CHK030 Is every invalid case in FR-003 and FR-033 mapped to a contract row, with none in the spec lacking a row? [Traceability, Spec §SC-003, Contracts §build-errors]
- [x] CHK031 Is the behaviour for several errors in one build defined (first only or all listed), and consistent between spec and contract? [Consistency, Contracts §build-errors]
- [x] CHK032 Is the unknown-topic message required to list the allowed topics in a stable order? [Clarity, Spec §US3-4]
- [x] CHK033 Is the feature-image description requirement consistent with body-image description requirements, including message wording? [Consistency, Spec §US3-5, FR-033]
- [x] CHK034 Is the failure mode for an unknown section tag in a post body specified in the spec, not only the contract? [Gap, Contracts §build-errors P19]
- [x] CHK035 Are build-stopping errors distinguished from warnings (for example an over-long summary or a large image), and is any warning tier defined? [Gap]
- [x] CHK036 Is it stated that errors must surface in CI and the Cloudflare build, not only locally? [Coverage, Spec §SC-003]

## Addresses and Slugs

- [x] CHK037 Is the slug derivation rule (file name without extension, case, character set) fully specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Contracts §build-errors P15]
- [x] CHK038 Is the reserved-address list (`all`, `topics`) complete, including the feed address and numeric slugs that could clash with page numbers? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK039 Are the consequences of renaming a post file for its address and inbound links stated (no redirects)? [Gap, Spec §FR-002, FR-005]
- [x] CHK040 Is page-1 address handling (`/writing/all/1/` not a page) specified for topic pages as well as all posts? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-001]
- [x] CHK041 Are trailing-slash and case rules for blog addresses stated consistently with the site's existing rules? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001]

## Ordering, Selection and Derived Values

- [x] CHK042 Is the tie-break for equal publication dates specified fully (title comparison rule, case, locale) so order is deterministic? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK043 Are the featured grid order and the lead story exclusion consistent between FR-008, FR-009 and the scenarios? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, FR-009, US2-3, US2-5]
- [x] CHK044 Is reading time defined measurably (words per minute, what counts as words in code and tables, rounding)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK045 Is the treatment of future-dated posts consistent with the feed and sitemap requirements? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-036]
- [x] CHK046 Is the authoring guide's required content traceable to each setting, the topic process, image syntax, code syntax, marks and every build error? [Traceability, Spec §FR-034]
- [x] CHK047 Is SC-002 ("exactly 1 file plus images, no other file edited") consistent with the topic-list and shared-note locations authors may need to edit? [Consistency, Spec §SC-002, FR-016, FR-027]
